newsitem.title: USA: San Antonio feeder cattle not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: San Antonio feeder cattle not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Not enough cattle on offer of any class for a market test, compared to last week, USDA said. Bulk of supply Medium and Large 1-2 300-600 lb feeder steers and heifers. Supply included around 2 percent cows and bulls, 30 percent feeder cattle over 600 lbs.
Feeder Steers - Medium and Large 1 - 600-675 lbs 72.25- 81.50. Medium and Large 1-2 - pkg 645 lbs 66.00.
Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 - 600-650 lbs 70.25-72.50; 700-950 lbs 62.25-66.00. Medium and Large 1-2 - 400-650 lbs 60.20-69.00.
